content.scenario: Rahul, a consumer, purchases a defective mobile phone from a retailer. The phone explodes, causing harm to Rahul. He files a complaint before the District Commission, seeking compensation for the harm caused.
content.outcome: The District Commission may order the manufacturer or seller to pay compensation to Rahul for the harm caused, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
